library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(msigdbr)






# 11.1. Import data


data_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/results"
raw_data_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/raw_data"

# Import full VST matrix
full_vsd <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "vst_full.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F,
  check.names=F,
  row.names=1
)

# Convert rownames (ENSG) to a column and map to gene symbols
ensg2gene <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "host_gene_counts.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
) %>%
  { `names<-`(.$gene_symbol, .$X) }

full_vsd <- full_vsd %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  mutate(
    gene_symbol = ensg2gene[gene],
    gene_symbol = ifelse(
      is.na(gene_symbol),
      gene,
      gene_symbol
    )
  )

# Import metadata
metadata_df_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "metadata_df_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

# Import microbe reports
microbe_reports_bgfilter <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "microbe_reports_bgfilter.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

# Load new metadata with mNGS hits
metadata_with_mNGS <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    raw_data_dir,
    "metadata_JCI_mNGS_hits_added_06122026.csv"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

# Import protein matrix
protein_mat <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/data/protein_mat.csv"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)






# 11.2. Select IFN plots


# Ensure same patients are used
microbe_reports_bgfilter <- microbe_reports_bgfilter %>%
  filter(
    sample_name %in% metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name
  )

# Filter to viruses only
virus_reports <- microbe_reports_bgfilter %>%
  filter(
    category == "viruses"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_name = factor(
      sample_name,
      levels = metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample_name)

# Run by sum viral rpm
viral_rpm_df <- virus_reports %>%
  group_by(sample_name) %>%
  summarize(
    viral_rpm = sum(nt_rpm, na.rm=T),
    .groups="drop"
  )

# Add back all patients
viral_rpm_df <- metadata_df_with_folds %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_name,
    LRTI_adjudication
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    viral_rpm_df,
    by="sample_name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    viral_rpm = ifelse(
      is.na(viral_rpm),
      0,
      viral_rpm
    )
  )

# Restrict to samples with viral mNGS hits
samples_with_viral_hits <- metadata_with_mNGS %>%
  filter(
    LRTI_adjudication == "Definite"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sanitized_name,
    starts_with("JCI_virus_")
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols=starts_with("JCI_virus_"),
    values_to="pathogen",
    values_drop_na=TRUE
  ) %>%
  filter(
    pathogen != ""
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sanitized_name
  ) %>%
  distinct()






# 11.2a. Select Gene IFNs


ifn_genes <- c(
  "ISG15",
  "IFIT2",
  "IFIT3"
)

rna_ifn_long <- full_vsd %>%
  filter(
    gene_symbol %in% ifn_genes
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols=-c(gene, gene_symbol),
    names_to="sample_name",
    values_to="expr"
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  mutate(
    expr_scaled = as.numeric(scale(expr))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

ifn_rna_df <- rna_ifn_long %>%
  left_join(
    viral_rpm_df %>%
      dplyr::select(
        sample_name,
        viral_rpm,
        LRTI_adjudication
      ),
    by="sample_name"
  )

# Restrict to Definite LRTI with viral mNGS hits only
ifn_rna_df_definite <- ifn_rna_df %>%
  filter(
    sample_name %in% samples_with_viral_hits$sanitized_name
  )






# 11.2b. Select Protein IFNs


ifn_proteins <- c(
  "ISG15",
  "IFIT2",
  "IFIT3"
)

protein_ifn_long <- protein_mat %>%
  { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
  mutate(
    patient_id = as.integer(patient_id)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    patient_id,
    all_of(ifn_proteins)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols=-patient_id,
    names_to="gene_symbol",
    values_to="expr_log2"
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  mutate(
    expr_scaled = as.numeric(scale(expr_log2))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    metadata_df_with_folds %>%
      dplyr::select(
        patient_id,
        sample_name
      ),
    by="patient_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    viral_rpm_df,
    by="sample_name"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    sample_name %in% samples_with_viral_hits$sanitized_name
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    modality = "Protein"
  )

ifn_rna_df_definite <- ifn_rna_df_definite %>%
  mutate(
    modality = "RNA"
  )






# 11.2c. Combine RNA/Protein


ifn_combined_df <- bind_rows(
  ifn_rna_df_definite %>%
    dplyr::select(
      sample_name,
      gene_symbol,
      expr_scaled,
      viral_rpm,
      modality
    ),
  protein_ifn_long %>%
    dplyr::select(
      sample_name,
      gene_symbol,
      expr_scaled,
      viral_rpm,
      modality
    )
)






# 11.2d. Viral RPM vs IFN plot


omics_colors <- c(
  "RNA" = "#0072B2",
  "Protein" = "#009073"
)

cor_ifn_df <- ifn_combined_df %>%
  group_by(
    modality,
    gene_symbol
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    pearson_r = cor.test(
      expr_scaled,
      log10(viral_rpm + 1),
      method="pearson"
    )$estimate,
    pearson_p = cor.test(
      expr_scaled,
      log10(viral_rpm + 1),
      method="pearson"
    )$p.value,
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    pearson_padj = p.adjust(
      pearson_p,
      method="BH"
    ),
    pearson_padj_fmt = signif(
      pearson_padj,
      2
    )
  )

interaction_p_df <- ifn_combined_df %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  summarize(
    interaction_p = summary(
      lm(
        expr_scaled ~
          log10(viral_rpm + 1) *
          as.character(modality),
        data=cur_data()
      )
    )$coefficients[
      "log10(viral_rpm + 1):as.character(modality)RNA",
      "Pr(>|t|)"
    ],
    .groups="drop"
  )

p_ifn_select <- ggplot(
  ifn_combined_df,
  aes(
    x=log10(viral_rpm + 1),
    y=expr_scaled,
    color=modality
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    alpha=0.7,
    size=1.6
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method="lm",
    se=TRUE,
    alpha=0.15
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept=0,
    linetype="dashed",
    color="grey40"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data=cor_ifn_df %>%
      group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
      mutate(
        y_pos=case_when(
          modality=="RNA" ~ 3.8,
          modality=="Protein" ~ 3.45
        )
      ),
    aes(
      x=max(
        log10(
          ifn_combined_df$viral_rpm + 1
        )
      ) * 0.98,
      y=y_pos,
      label=paste0(
        modality,
        ": r = ",
        formatC(
          pearson_r,
          format="f",
          digits=2
        ),
        ", Padj = ",
        pearson_padj_fmt
      )
    ),
    inherit.aes=FALSE,
    size=3,
    hjust=1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data=interaction_p_df,
    aes(
      x=max(
        log10(
          ifn_combined_df$viral_rpm + 1
        )
      ) * 0.98,
      y=3.1,
      label=paste0(
        "Interaction p = ",
        round(
          interaction_p,
          3
        )
      )
    ),
    inherit.aes=FALSE,
    size=3,
    hjust=1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~gene_symbol
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim=c(-3, 3.8)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values=omics_colors
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size=12,

  ) +
  theme(

    ),

print(p_ifn_select)

# 11.3. Composite IFN score plot


ifn_geneset <- msigdbr(
  species="Homo sapiens",
  collection="H"
) %>%
  filter(
    gs_name %in% c(
      "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE"
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(gene_symbol) %>%
  unique()

hallmark_ifn_genes <- intersect(
  ifn_geneset,
  full_vsd$gene_symbol
)

cat(
  "IFN alpha genes in RNA data:",
  length(hallmark_ifn_genes),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "IFN alpha genes in protein data:",
  sum(
    hallmark_ifn_genes %in%
      colnames(protein_mat)[-1]
  ),
  "\n"
)

hallmark_ifn_genes_shared <- intersect(
  hallmark_ifn_genes,
  colnames(protein_mat)[-1]
)

cat(
  "Shared IFN alpha genes (in both RNA and protein):",
  length(hallmark_ifn_genes_shared),
  "\n"
)


# Build IFN score for a given set of sample RPM values
build_ifn_score <- function(rpm_df) {

  bind_rows(

    # RNA
    full_vsd %>%
      filter(
        gene_symbol %in% hallmark_ifn_genes
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols=-c(gene, gene_symbol),
        names_to="sample_name",
        values_to="expr"
      ) %>%
      group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
      mutate(
        expr_scaled=as.numeric(
          scale(expr)
        )
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      group_by(sample_name) %>%
      summarize(
        IFN_score=mean(
          expr_scaled,
          na.rm=T
        ),
        .groups="drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        modality="RNA"
      ),

    # Protein
    protein_mat %>%
      { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
      mutate(
        patient_id=as.integer(patient_id)
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols=-patient_id,
        names_to="gene_symbol",
        values_to="expr_log2"
      ) %>%
      filter(
        gene_symbol %in%
          intersect(
            hallmark_ifn_genes,
            colnames(protein_mat)[-1]
          )
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        metadata_df_with_folds %>%
          dplyr::select(
            patient_id,
            sample_name
          ),
        by="patient_id"
      ) %>%
      group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
      mutate(
        expr_scaled=as.numeric(
          scale(expr_log2)
        )
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      group_by(sample_name) %>%
      summarize(
        IFN_score=mean(
          expr_scaled,
          na.rm=T
        ),
        .groups="drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        modality="Protein"
      )

  ) %>%
    inner_join(
      rpm_df,
      by="sample_name"
    )
}


# Build IFN score using only shared genes (present in both RNA and protein)
build_ifn_score_shared <- function(rpm_df) {

  bind_rows(

    full_vsd %>%
      filter(
        gene_symbol %in%
          hallmark_ifn_genes_shared
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols=-c(gene, gene_symbol),
        names_to="sample_name",
        values_to="expr"
      ) %>%
      group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
      mutate(
        expr_scaled=as.numeric(
          scale(expr)
        )
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      group_by(sample_name) %>%
      summarize(
        IFN_score=mean(
          expr_scaled,
          na.rm=T
        ),
        .groups="drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        modality="RNA"
      ),

    protein_mat %>%
      { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
      mutate(
        patient_id=as.integer(patient_id)
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols=-patient_id,
        names_to="gene_symbol",
        values_to="expr_log2"
      ) %>%
      filter(
        gene_symbol %in%
          hallmark_ifn_genes_shared
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        metadata_df_with_folds %>%
          dplyr::select(
            patient_id,
            sample_name
          ),
        by="patient_id"
      ) %>%
      group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
      mutate(
        expr_scaled=as.numeric(
          scale(expr_log2)
        )
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      group_by(sample_name) %>%
      summarize(
        IFN_score=mean(
          expr_scaled,
          na.rm=T
        ),
        .groups="drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        modality="Protein"
      )

  ) %>%
    inner_join(
      rpm_df,
      by="sample_name"
    )
}


# Helper function: compute correlations
compute_cor <- function(
  score_df,
  rpm_col="viral_rpm"
) {

  score_df %>%
    group_by(modality) %>%
    summarize(
      n_obs=n(),
      pearson_r=if(
        n() >= 3
      ) {
        cor.test(
          IFN_score,
          log10(
            .data[[rpm_col]] + 1
          ),
          method="pearson"
        )$estimate
      } else {
        NA
      },
      pearson_p=if(
        n() >= 3
      ) {
        cor.test(
          IFN_score,
          log10(
            .data[[rpm_col]] + 1
          ),
          method="pearson"
        )$p.value
      } else {
        NA
      },
      .groups="drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      pearson_padj=p.adjust(
        pearson_p,
        method="BH"
      ),
      pearson_padj_fmt=signif(
        pearson_padj,
        2
      ),
      y_pos=case_when(
        modality=="RNA" ~ -1.3,
        modality=="Protein" ~ -1.5
      )
    )
}


# Helper function: make plot
make_ifn_plot <- function(
  score_df,
  cor_df,
  interaction_p,
  n_cases,
  x_label,
  title,
  subtitle,
  filename
) {

  p <- ggplot(
    score_df,
    aes(
      x=log10(viral_rpm + 1),
      y=IFN_score,
      color=modality
    )
  ) +

    geom_point(
      alpha=0.7,
      size=1.8
    ) +

    geom_smooth(
      method="lm",
      se=TRUE,
      alpha=0.15
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept=0,
      linetype="dashed",
      color="grey40"
    ) +

    # Correlation information
    geom_text(
      data=cor_df,
      aes(
        x=max(
          log10(
            score_df$viral_rpm + 1
          )
        ) * 0.98,
        y=y_pos,
        label=paste0(
          modality,
          ": r = ",
          formatC(
            pearson_r,
            format="f",
            digits=2
          )
        )
      ),
      inherit.aes=FALSE,
      size=4,
      hjust=1
    ) +

    # Interaction p-value
    annotate(
      "text",
      x=max(
        log10(
          score_df$viral_rpm + 1
        )
      ) * 0.98,
      y=-1.7,
      label=ifelse(
        interaction_p < 0.001,
        "Interaction p < 0.001",
        paste0(
          "Interaction p = ",
          formatC(
            interaction_p,
            format="e",
            digits=2
          )
        )
      ),
      size=4,
      hjust=1
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(
      ylim=c(-2.0, 1.5)
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values=omics_colors
    ) +

    theme_classic(
      base_size=12,
      base_family="Arial"
    ) +

    theme(
      text=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=12,
        face="plain"
      ),
      axis.text=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=12,
        color="black",
        face="plain"
      ),
      axis.title=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=12,
        color="black",
        face="plain"
      ),
      legend.position="bottom",
      legend.direction="horizontal",
      legend.text=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=12,
        face="plain"
      ),
      legend.title=element_blank(),
      plot.title=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=12,
        hjust=0.5,
        face="plain"
      ),
      plot.margin=margin(
        10,
        10,
        10,
        10
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      x=x_label,
      y="IFN alpha score (z-score)",
      title=title
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      results_dir,
      filename
    ),
    p,
    width=6.5,
    height=6.5,
    device=cairo_pdf,
    bg="white"
  )
}


# Define RSV and rhinovirus sample sets upfront

# 11.3a. Viral load vs IFN - ALL VIRAL mNGS HITS (n=62 Definite)


samples_with_viral_hits <- metadata_with_mNGS %>%
  filter(
    LRTI_adjudication=="Definite"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sanitized_name,
    starts_with("JCI_virus_")
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols=starts_with("JCI_virus_"),
    values_to="pathogen",
    values_drop_na=TRUE
  ) %>%
  filter(
    pathogen != ""
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sanitized_name
  ) %>%
  distinct()

viral_all_hits <- microbe_reports_bgfilter %>%
  filter(
    category=="viruses",
    sample_name %in%
      samples_with_viral_hits$sanitized_name
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_name) %>%
  summarize(
    viral_rpm=sum(
      nt_rpm,
      na.rm=TRUE
    ),
    .groups="drop"
  )

message(
  "11.3a - n samples with viral hits: ",
  nrow(viral_all_hits)
)

ifn_score_viral_all <- build_ifn_score(
  viral_all_hits
)

cor_viral_all <- compute_cor(
  ifn_score_viral_all
)

interaction_p_viral_all <- summary(
  lm(
    IFN_score ~
      log10(viral_rpm + 1) *
      as.character(modality),
    data=ifn_score_viral_all
  )
)$coefficients[
  "log10(viral_rpm + 1):as.character(modality)RNA",
  "Pr(>|t|)"
]

make_ifn_plot(
  score_df=ifn_score_viral_all,
  cor_df=cor_viral_all,
  interaction_p=interaction_p_viral_all,
  n_cases=nrow(viral_all_hits),
  x_label=expression(
    log[10]~"viral RPM (+1)"
  ),
  title="Composite IFN alpha score versus viral abundance",
  subtitle=NULL,
  filename="Viral_All_vs_IFNa_mNGS.pdf"
)

# 11.3b. RSV specific (n=43 Definite)


viral_rsv_hits <- microbe_reports_bgfilter %>%
  filter(
    category=="viruses",
    sample_name %in%
      samples_with_rsv$sanitized_name,
    grepl(
      "orthopneumovirus|respiratory syncytial virus",
      name,
      ignore.case=TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_name) %>%
  summarize(
    viral_rpm=sum(
      nt_rpm,
      na.rm=TRUE
    ),
    .groups="drop"
  )

message(
  "11.3b - n RSV samples: ",
  nrow(viral_rsv_hits)
)

ifn_score_rsv <- build_ifn_score(
  viral_rsv_hits
)

cor_rsv <- compute_cor(
  ifn_score_rsv
)

interaction_p_rsv <- summary(
  lm(
    IFN_score ~
      log10(viral_rpm + 1) *
      as.character(modality),
    data=ifn_score_rsv
  )
)$coefficients[
  "log10(viral_rpm + 1):as.character(modality)RNA",
  "Pr(>|t|)"
]

make_ifn_plot(
  score_df=ifn_score_rsv,
  cor_df=cor_rsv,
  interaction_p=interaction_p_rsv,
  n_cases=nrow(viral_rsv_hits),
  x_label=expression(
    log[10]~"RSV RPM (+1)"
  ),
  title="RSV load versus IFN alpha response",
  subtitle=NULL,
  filename="RSV_vs_IFNa_mNGS.pdf"
)


# Sensitivity: exclude the 2 cases with both RSV and rhinovirus
samples_rsv_only <- samples_with_rsv %>%
  filter(

)
